oracle.activityBoundary: every callActivity argument and return value crosses oracle/lib/boundary.js, as the Durable Task extension serialises them; OutboundInformantRegister therefore receives the ORCHESTRATOR's hearing, not the copy SetInformantRegister mutated

contract.basis: a reference-data outage or a transient 5xx is an operational condition, not a payload; nothing in any schema forbids it
contract.note: Parity obligation: the Java port must reproduce this.

evidence: CONSTRUCTED — the failure is injected at the axios boundary by this harness

provenance.note: Two prosecution authorities (TFL, TVL), no courtCentre fields, hearingDays empty.
provenance.operatorDescription: Makes the now-subscriptions GET fail instead of answering.
provenance.operatorRationale: ReferenceDataService.js:50-53 SWALLOWS the failure and returns null, so InformantRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:22 takes the "No Subscriptions found" exit and the pipeline emits documents with NO recipients. A reference-data outage silently produces a register nobody receives — this is the swallowed-failure class the new service exists to remove, and the Java port must be able to tell it apart from "there genuinely are no subscriptions".

operatorDetail.why: the retry loop RECOVERING — AxiosRetryWrapper.js:34 is false for 500, so :38-39 sleeps and retries, and the second attempt answers 200. Documents are produced WITH recipients despite a failed first attempt. No always-fail or always-succeed stub can reach this path, and a Java port that treats the first 5xx as terminal silently loses every recipient
